sourceFile: 22. TIU C11-20  Report Test VP stock date 6.1 check function 2026.1.29_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable comparison evidence but misstates the changed factor and includes invalid header-derived measurement statistics.
issues: Changed factor should be VP date 6/1 sample versus normal date 29/1, not day shift versus TIU C11-20R.
L/R model or side is mixed between changed condition and subgroup context.
Rows 14 and 18 are key test rows but their extracted text is not shown in contextRows.
Measurement outcome is header-derived and not a valid separate measurement result.
Normal rows 16 and 20 may represent separate matched baselines and should not be pooled blindly.
requiredUserQuestions: Should TIU C11-20L and TIU C11-20R be treated as separate subgroup comparisons?
Which normal row matches each L/R test row, if matching is required?
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to VP stock/date 6/1 sample check versus normal date 29/1.
Use TIU C11-20L/R and shift/date as subgroup keys only unless source proves they are the changed factor.
Expose and cite row text for Test!14 and Test!18.
Remove measurement-1 or convert defect columns into breakdown subresults under function defect outcome.
Keep rows 14,16,18,20 as row-level subresults with input, OK, total NG, and NG rate.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but key test-row text and corrected grouping are required before final evidence use.
